snippet.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore the Honeyglow Woods, and reconnect with Disney's Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore and Piglet in a brand-new Adventure Pack! Decorate 4 new areas, learn the art of beekeeping, craft all-new items using Golden Honey, and uncover the mystery behind the Everoak Tree.

Play Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods now: https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/editions/hw-dlc

Join the community on:
Instagram: http://instagram.com/disneydreamlightvalley
X: http://x.com/DisneyDLV
Facebook: http://facebook.com/DisneyDreamlightValley
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@disneydreamlightvalley"
